vibe_rationale: Huge, devoted trail-running community and a town-wide festival week, but corporate and heavily branded through UTMB and HOKA.
fit_notes: Adult endurance and trail-running crowd (8,000 entries for 2027, 47 per cent first-timers), the strongest health-relevance match in the region, with clear recovery and nutrition needs. HOKA holds naming and UTMB's global partners set category deals, so access is likely a village-level role at high cost. A partner page exists, so a smaller supporter role is worth asking about.
